collect-signin-language.claim: The sign-in screen has a language picker with English, Spanish, Haitian Creole; Settings > Language too.

collect-signup-fields.claim: Sign-up asks for first/last name, email (required), optional phone, password twice; records carry the surveyor name.

collect-signup-org.claim: Organization field suggests existing organizations; a clearly new name creates it with you as admin; too-close names are refused but the account is created, storing the typed name.

collect-forgot-password.claim: Forgot Password asks for the email and sends a reset link.

evidence.quote: "enterEmail": "Please enter your email to reset your password",

collect-org-change.claim: The organization cannot be changed in the app; email info@puente-dr.org.

collect-one-account.claim: One account (email + password) works in Collect and Manage.

collect-tabs.claim: Five icon-only tabs: search, folder, home, cloud-upload, cog; screen readers read their titles.

collect-home-default.claim: Home is the first tab shown; it greets by name and shows the organization.

collect-home-cards.claim: Home cards count forms (org activity and My Surveys across all form types); 7/30/all filters; tap for details; offline shows cached data.

evidence.quote: count: mySurveysCurrent + myVitalsCurrent + myEnvHealthCurrent + myMedEvalCurrent + myCustomFormsCurrent,
// recentActivity mirrors orgSurveys — org-wide activity across all form types

collect-forms-tab.claim: The folder opens Collect Data with Puente Forms, Pinned Forms, Custom Forms, Workflows. Pinned Forms sits just below Puente Forms.

collect-sync-manual.claim: Sync is manual: the Offline screen only tracks status; sending happens on Retry.

evidence.quote: "offlineBanner": "You're offline. Records will save and sync automatically."

collect-coachmarks.claim: Home, forms, Find and Settings each show a one-time tip; Got it closes it.

evidence.quote: The overlay automatically handles AsyncStorage persistence and won't show twice

collect-reset-onboarding.claim: Reset Onboarding brings back the tour and tips; records unaffected.

evidence.quote: "resetOnboardingWarning": "The tutorial will show again next time you open the app. Your saved records are not affected.",

collect-rid-start.claim: Resident ID is the first Puente form; forms open on consent first.

collect-rid-fields.claim: Resident ID fields; required: first, last name, sex, marriage status, education level.

collect-rid-save.claim: Button reads Empty Form / Save Record; missing required fields listed; the alert says saved offline, name + submitted, or ERROR!; the page behind it always shows Form successfully submitted.

collect-suggested-next.claim: After Resident ID, Suggested next forms lists pinned forms; tapping keeps the same resident; forms can also start from a resident record. A pinned Resident ID opens a new, blank registration (IdentificationForm takes no surveyee).

collect-rid-location.claim: Location is a tapped button; a 20 s timeout or error sets the saved value to 0,0 (the on-screen coordinates from an earlier tap are not reset) and shows an error.

collect-rid-photo.claim: Photo Assessment: take a photo or use the camera roll; optional.

collect-household-options.claim: Household offers Do Nothing, Create a new household, Link to an existing house.

collect-household-nothing.claim: Do Nothing shows a message and an Add or Create a Household button.

collect-household-create.claim: Create: tap the Household button; the success message shows immediately (set outside the save's promise); a failed save shows the ERROR! alert.

collect-household-link.claim: Link: search a person, choose a relationship, submit; Linked shows before the save resolves and a failure alerts ERROR!. The link posts a new Household row whose id replaces this person's householdId; the server ignores the chosen person's household id (postObject reads only localObject).

evidence.quote: alert("You must search and select an individual."); //eslint-disable-line

collect-households-not-listed.claim: Offline households are not in the Offline Sync list or count. They are posted only with the rest of the queue; with no other form waiting there is no Retry button and the upload returns early.

collect-duplicates.claim: Duplicates can be deleted in Manage Data Curation.

evidence.quote: "data_curation_dup_delete_confirm": "Permanently delete this record? This cannot be undone.",

collect-builtin-forms.claim: Four Puente forms; Manage names them by class.

collect-builtin-fixed.claim: The Puente forms are defined in the app itself, the same everywhere.

collect-env-fields.claim: Environmental Health questions; number of people in the house required.

collect-vitals-fields.claim: Vitals measurements with units; none required.

collect-attach-resident.claim: Supplementary forms need an attached resident; search box above; button reads Attach a Community Resident. Search results are a list of names; tapping one selects the person.

collect-supp-saved.claim: Supplementary and custom forms show Saved offline only when the resident is still local; a form queued offline for a synced resident shows Form successfully submitted; a failed save shows ERROR!; queued custom forms are listed by title (their saved answers carry no person name).

collect-custom-source.claim: Custom forms are built in Form Creator (type Custom), published, and Collect lists the organization's Custom forms under every spelling. Only active forms (active !== 'false') are kept.

collect-publish-silent.claim: Manage does not show publish failures.

collect-custom-refresh.claim: The phone keeps saved custom forms; the refresh arrow fetches them; offline keeps the stored list; Download records for offline use also fetches them.

collect-custom-attach.claim: Custom forms open on consent, then the resident search; need an attached resident. Search results are a list of names; tapping one selects the person.

collect-pin.claim: Long-press pins a form; long-press a pinned one unpins; stored on the phone. Pinned Forms sits just below Puente Forms.

evidence.quote: "noPinnedForms": "No pinned forms yet — long-press any form to pin it"

collect-pin-cleared.claim: Delete Credentials on the sign-in screen clears pinned forms.

collect-workflows.claim: Workflows groups custom forms; Form Creator publishes no workflow, so they appear under No Workflow Assigned. Workflow groups are built when the gallery mounts; the refresh arrow re-fetches forms without regrouping.

collect-custom-manage.claim: Custom form records appear under the form in Form Manager, with Export.

collect-consent-screen.claim: Every form opens on the Consent Form screen with summary, View Full Policy, checkbox, Continue to Form.

collect-consent-summary.claim: The summary lists what Collect stores, who may see it, no advertising use, policy date. Puente staff can also reach every organization's records.

evidence.quote: including contact details, demographics, household and location information, precise GPS coordinates, photographs, health information, form responses, and account identifiers
Records may be available to authorized users of the organization collecting them.
Puente does not use this app data for advertising, product personalization, or tracking.

collect-consent-full-policy.claim: View Full Policy opens a window with Open Current Policy linking the Privacy Policy, and Ok.

collect-consent-required.claim: Without the tick, Continue shows Community member must consent; the box starts unticked every time.

collect-consent-back.claim: A Back button above the form leaves it.

collect-consent-org-scope.claim: Each organization's apps show its own records.

evidence.quote: Scoped to every `surveyingOrganization` string the organization goes by

collect-offline-banner.claim: Offline banner on the forms screen and forms; Home shows cached data.

collect-save-messages.claim: Resident ID shows Saved offline when queued, otherwise Form successfully submitted. Supplementary and custom forms show Saved offline only when the resident is still local, so a form queued offline for a synced resident shows Form successfully submitted. A failed save shows ERROR! and queues nothing.

evidence.quote: "savedOffline": "Saved offline — will sync when you reconnect",

collect-queue-screen.claim: Offline Sync shows status, count, Waiting to sync list with Discard, Last synced, all-caught-up message.

evidence.quote: "queuedOne": "1 form is saved on this device and has not reached the server yet.",
"noForms": "No forms queued. You are all caught up!",

collect-retry.claim: Retry sends the queue; success shows Success! You have just submitted N.

collect-partial-sync.claim: Partial failure keeps unsent forms queued and prunes the saved ones; the Offline Sync screen resets its count from the pre-upload value and does not reload the list until it is refocused.

evidence.quote: Some records reached Parse and some did not.
`saved` map and leave the rest queued for a retry.

collect-sync-failures.claim: Failure messages: failed attempt, still on device, offline vs server refused, session expired.

collect-discard.claim: Discard asks first, warns it is permanent; Discard permanently confirms.

evidence.quote: Discarding deletes it from this device permanently and it cannot be recovered.

collect-logout-guard.claim: Logout is blocked offline and warns about unsynced records online.

evidence.quote: "logoutMessage": "You will need your username and password to log back in.",

collect-settings-unsynced.claim: Settings shows the number of records waiting.

collect-settings-list.claim: Settings tab list: Name/Phone/Email, Change Password, Find Records, Language, Offline Records, Theme, Calm Mode, Reset Onboarding.

collect-settings-online-only.claim: Account changes need a connection; new password at least 8 characters, confirmed.

evidence.quote: "offlineMessage": "You are offline. This change needs an internet connection, and has not been saved."
"tooShort": "Your new password must be at least 8 characters.",

collect-language-settings.claim: Language opens Choose Language with English, Spanish, Haitian Creole.

collect-settings-storage-limit.claim: Find Records shows stored count and Record storage limit, default 2000.

collect-offline-records.claim: Offline Records: download or clear resident records; clearing does not touch the sync queue.

collect-theme-calm.claim: Theme Light/Dark; Calm Mode reduces animations with ON/OFF.

collect-support.claim: Support: Help Center; Contact us/Feedback emails info@; Rate our app; Delete user? opens account page.

evidence.quote: Records you have already submitted belong to your organization and are not removed by this.

collect-consent-suggested.claim: Forms opened from Suggested next forms after a Resident ID skip the consent screen, because consent is screen state set once at the start of the Resident ID and not reset; it is not saved with the record.
